en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a very large winter crowd filling a broad city street and adjacent tree-lined promenade. People wear long coats, fur hats, shawls and headscarves, suggesting a cold climate in the early 20th century. A brick public building with decorative masonry lines the left side, and tram or trolley wires run above the street. In the center distance some people hold a flag or banner, indicating a march, rally, or demonstration. Bare trees and snow on the ground frame the right side; the image has the appearance of a historic postcard view of a northern European city during a mass gathering.
